components.note: def:p15-global-model (P 26-33) separates uncertainty analysis (distribution, variance, quantiles, exceedance of Y), sensitivity analysis (attribution relative to specified changes) and local derivatives / finite coordinate changes, and states neither local object specifies the output distribution. P 494-502 separates input-explained from remaining variance for stochastic outputs. Worked cases answer spread and attribution separately: product case V=1/9 vs S_i=0, S_Ti=1 (P 311-321); ranking theorem keeps derivative coefficients fixed while indices reverse (P 522). No passage calls a local derivative a complete global analysis.

Finite interaction counterexamples with written proofs: f_C=C(x1-b1)(x2-b2) agrees with 0 on all OAT lines (P 69-81, A 2-15); Y=X1X2 has every OAT evaluation zero but S_Ti=1 (P 311-321, A 235-249); D-function mixed contrast 81/35 (P 411-416, A 314-319). Source domain-coverage reasoning: inscribed-ball ratio r_d, r_12 ~ 0.000326, with proof (P 83-102, A 17-63) and its scope limits (P 99-109). Held source opened (sha256 matches held-sources.json): SaltelliAnnoni2010 p.1510 Sec.3 'OAT can't work. A geometric proof' (r(2)~0.78, r(3)~0.52, r=0.000326 in 12 dimensions, Fig.1) and p.1510 interaction-detection paragraph plus Sec.4 EE-as-correction; route matches. Alternatives worked: two-level factorial, standardized regression, elementary effects, variance-based pick-freeze (P 118-365). Zero OAT difference explicitly not global irrelevance (P 62-64, 305-307).

S_i=Var(E[Y|X_i])/V and S_Ti=E[Var(Y|X_-i)]/V defined (P 269-282) with interpretations via thm:p15-conditional-variance (exists at handbook/parts/p15/conditional-expectation.tex:279). Product-law assumptions stated (P 237-243). Derivation from conditional expectations through the orthogonal decomposition, with written proofs: ANOVA (A 141-193); S_i=V_{i}/V, S_Ti=sum V_u/V, bounds, additivity and factor fixing (A 196-232; factorization result exists as thm:p15-conditional-factorization). Held source opened: SaltelliAnnoni2010 p.1512 Sec.5.4 Eqs.(1)-(2) define Si and STi with the same reduction/remaining-variance readings and STi for factor fixing; route matches. Dependence not ignored (P 464-476, A 323-338); sensitivity not confused with causal effect (P 478-492, A 341-359).
Range-driven reversal and threshold failure fully worked with proof; failure condition avoided (ranking tied to input law, P 519-526). Model-assumption half is procedural only.
components.gap: Ranking and threshold change is worked only across input ranges (P 509-527, A 362-392, incl. family criterion l1>=4u2). For changed model assumptions other than range width (dependence structure, model formulation or variant), no passage reports how a ranking or threshold status changes: thm:p15-global-dependent-boundary (P 464-476) gives index values under dependence but does not state the ranking/threshold consequence relative to the independent law, and def:p15-global-lookup (P 538-540) only instructs the reader to recompute. The 'and model assumptions' half of the success condition is not demonstrated.
